text:
Alex C.: Heads up — FinEdge asked us to provide an emergency unlock/unwrap artifact for their BYO-HSM cutover. They want a signed authorization they can present during the ceremony.
Maria L.: Do they mean an offline token or something consumed via our service? clarify pls.
Alex C.: They described an offline "pre-signed" blob that proves Redwood authorized a one-time unwrap during the cutover if their custodian needs it. Legal flagged auditing requirements.
Jordan R.: Security note: issuing an offline-signed escape hatch has risks. We can emit a time-bound, single-use JWT that calls our key-proxy, but totally offline unwrap requires escrowed key material and a formal ceremony.
Sam I.: Operationally we can support both patterns: (1) networked escape hatch: signed JWT -> our proxy unwraps; (2) offline fallback: key-escrow package + HSM custody steps. The latter requires PS and an on-call custodian window.
Maria L.: Pricing question from procurement: is key-escrow / on-site ceremony included in the standard BYO-HSM SOW?
Jordan R.: Standard SOW includes onboarding and two verification rotations. Anything beyond (extra ceremonies, on-site support, recovery drills) is billed as professional services. We'll need to itemize days and travel if on-site.
Alex C.: Also asked whether unwraps during cutover are charged at standard API rates or as a special HSM operation.
Sam I.: Unwraps are treated as KMS operations. For BYO-HSM we charge the monthly connector plus a small per-unwrap fee when routed through the customer-managed path. I'll attach the fee schedule to the 1-pager.
Kevin O.: Legal wants to see: TTL semantics, revocation model, audit trail retention, and sample attestation text for the artifact.
Alex C.: Can we give them a short playbook for staging validation and prod cutover expectations? They requested firewall rules, test commands, and success criteria.
Jordan R.: I'll draft a concise runbook: pre-checks (HSM health, ACLs, cert chain), staging rotation using sandbox key test-key-rot-2025, staging validation (3 canary requests + log check), prod cutover (two-phase unwrap: canary 15m then full traffic), rollback (flip to redwood-managed-key for 10m). Include sample curl for staging: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging.kms.redwood-inference/api/v1/unwrap \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"<base64>"}'
```
Sam I.: Network notes: allow outbound to staging.kms.redwood:443, attestation.redwood:443, and NTP for ceremony time sync. If they use air-gapped HSMs we need manual transfer steps.
Maria L.: Timeline: they want 2 weeks for staging and a 48h prod cutover. Ops: is that feasible?
Jordan R.: 2 weeks staging OK. Prod cutover needs scheduling buffer — we require a 72h ops lead time and an ops dry-run 48–72h prior to prod. Also reserve HSM custodian for the window.
Alex C.: Blocker: they insist on explicit revocation mechanics for the pre-signed artifact.
Kevin O.: Suggest wording: "Signed authorization is single-use, TTL-limited, and may be revoked by Redwood control plane; all revocations are logged and retained for 7 years." I'll review exact phrasing if Maria sends draft.
Alex C.: Replication question: if they rotate in primary region, will replicated CMKs in other regions have matching versions?
Jordan R.: Replication is asynchronous. We guarantee eventual propagation but not atomic version parity. Recommend conducting rotation in the region that will serve traffic, or run ordered promotion if cross-region parity is required.
Maria L.: I'll assemble PS estimate, timeline, legal draft, and the runbook into a 1-page summary and share with FinEdge. Alex: please collect their custodian contact and firewall egress list.
Alex C.: Will do. ops-bot please create ticket for runbook work.
ops-bot: Created issue REDWOOD-POC-421 assigned to Jordan R., Sam I. ETA 5 business days.
Sam I.: I'll provision a staging connector and book a dry-run slot.
Maria L.: Thanks all. I'll loop in finance and legal and aim to send the 1-pager EOD.
Kevin O.: Send me the draft, I'll return markup within 24 hours.
Alex C.: Sharing update with FinEdge now.
